test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
A > B means 'A is the mother of B'

A! B means 'A is the sister of B'

A = B means 'A is the father of B'

If M > N = O ! P ! Q, then how is M related to Q?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599c31a3b6c5ca06ce1787b908a152975e0540fada6e60ee63a4282f38f5a661.png] 

A > B means 'A is the mother of B'

A! B means 'A is the sister of B'

A = B means 'A is the father of B'

 
 

 Symbol
 >
 !
 =
 
 

 Meaning
 Mother
 Sister
 Father
 
 

The given expression is :-

'M > N = O ! P ! Q' → M is mother of N, N is father of O, O is sister of P, P is sister of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc0d77a924f21a017652e861e7329692dcc570b0ed2bb36e015be6db891bce0e.png] 

∴ Here, 'M' is Father's mother's of 'Q'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Father's mother".**
